summary: Whisperstream is free and open source. Lanreal's original contributions are licensed under GNU GPL version 3 only. You may use, modify and redistribute the covered software under that license; upstream MIT and other component notices remain in effect. Corresponding Source is available at github.com/lanreal-io/whisperstream.

The app retains its processing acknowledgment and separate cloud-provider consent, optional model terms and Lockdown controls. This acknowledgment does not add a condition to your GPL rights or prevent you from modifying the app. Included functionality is free of charge and requires no activation.

Model downloads use pinned Hugging Face sources, with verified GitHub backups for supported speech models. Kokoro downloads use Hugging Face only. Downloads send connection metadata, not audio or transcripts; compatible cached models remain usable.

Built from source, the app makes no update requests. The official installer checks for signed updates and installs one only after you accept; update requests go to Cloudflare R2 with connection metadata only. Lockdown stops them.

Optional models and language data keep their own licenses, including GPL-licensed eSpeak components and language data used by upstream Kokoro. Supertonic's OpenRAIL-M restrictions apply only to that model; they do not restrict the GPL-covered application or Kokoro. Preserve model notices, including Stream-1 Mini by Whisperstream attribution.

The software carries the GPL warranty disclaimer. This notice does not modify separate agreements; source-code, relinking and other applicable obligations, prior permissions and mandatory rights remain unaffected. Earlier acceptance evidence is preserved.
Bug reports and feature requests open GitHub Issues in your browser. Issues and attachments are public. The app does not upload your content automatically.
